meta.name: how-it-works
meta.description: Explain how claude-mem captures observations, when memory injection kicks in, and where data lives. Use when the user asks "how does claude-mem work?" or "what is this thing doing?".

copy.tagline: 解释 claude-mem 的工作原理与数据存储方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果用户常问 claude-mem 如何工作或数据存哪里
copy.tagline_en: Explain how claude-mem works and where data is stored
copy.fit_line_en: For you if users often ask how claude-mem works or where data lives

howto.what: Claude 每次 Read、Edit、Bash 都会生成一条压缩观察,会话结束时被汇总,相关观察会自动注入之后的对话,让新会话带着上次的上下文开始。
howto.when: 在一个项目里的第二次会话开始注入记忆,首次会话先做播种。也可运行 /learn-codebase,一次性把整个仓库导入记忆(约 5 分钟,可选)。

say.note: 它会讲解观察的采集、注入时机与数据位置。

say.text: 这个插件现在在做什么?
say.note: 它会说明当前记忆采集与注入的状态。

say.text: 我的记忆数据存在哪里?
say.note: 它会告诉你数据放在本机的 ~/.claude-mem。

howto.what_en: Every Read, Edit, and Bash Claude makes becomes a compressed observation. Observations are summarized at session end, and relevant ones are auto-injected into later prompts so a new session starts with context from the last one.
howto.when_en: Memory injection begins on your second session in a project; the first session seeds memory. You can also run /learn-codebase to load the whole repo in one pass (~5 minutes, optional).

say_en.note: It explains capture, injection timing, and data location.

say_en.text: What is this thing doing right now?
say_en.note: It describes the current capture and injection state.

say_en.text: Where does my memory data live?
say_en.note: It tells you data stays in ~/.claude-mem on this machine.
